title: From Directions to Regions: Decomposing Activations in Language Models via Local Geometry
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and activation decomposition for concept discovery and steering in LLMs. It evaluates its methods using benchmarks like RAVEL and MCQA, which target entity-level causal variables (such as geography and language) and positional pointers, rather than religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
